contract: unicode_collation_key_codepoints accepts checked IntegerBuffer values0..10FFFF, including individual surrogate codepoint values as UCA implicit elements. It directly copies/transforms IntegerBuffer data, sharing UCD decomposition/order/composition with the UTF8 API. No UTF8 roundtrip, surrogate-pair fusion, replacement character, or input mutation. Invalid range returns status5 and an empty closeable key. Strict Utf8Text behavior remains unchanged.
positive: adjacent raw surrogate values remain distinct in identical key level
exact unchanged original collation-000413.bin all512 rows native0
negative: negative and greater-than10FFFF codepoint values rejected with5
UTF8 surrogate append rejected with5 and prior bytes/scalar count preserved
key budget failure returns empty error key and preserves input
